goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: RE-LOCKED compute budget (2026-08-09, after iter-19/v32). The canonical kernel train.ipynb runs at EXACTLY this. These are compute levers only: DO NOT inflate limit_chars/epochs/block_size to lower loss (compute inflation, rejected by push rule). The 10M/bs384 experiment (v27) was NON-CONVERGENT (2.26 BPC, hardy-aardvark-18/w7to9wg0) and is rejected; 30M/bs96 converges and delivered 1.7187 BPC. Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are NOT locked and MAY be tuned/swept. Steps/epoch auto-rescale to actual batch via steps_per_epoch_estimate().

current_best.time_to_convergence: ~31.9 min (1912s fit) to 1.7187 BPC @ E38 at RE-LOCKED 30M/512/40ep/bs96 budget. Crossed old best 1.8833 by ~E12. Fastest run ever (vectorized ds + spe16).
current_best.notes: Iter-19 (v32, run 8dapi5ep warm-armadillo-23) = NEW BEST 1.7187 BPC @ E38. Winning lever = token-decoder scaling (tdec3/ff256 1.8833 -> tdec4/ff384 1.8483 -> tdec5/ff512 1.79396 -> tdec6/ff768 1.7187); gains GROWING per step. chunk-side scale-up (12L/2560) regressed (1.8483->1.8749) and reverted to 8L/2048. QK-norm (rec 5) landed green and is ON. v27 10M/384 budget NON-CONVERGENT (2.26 BPC) -> budget re-locked to 30M/96. Progression: 3.493 -> 3.268 -> 3.011 -> 2.5909 -> 2.3023 -> 2.2878 -> 2.2597 -> 1.8869 -> 1.8833 -> [1.9049 bigram regression] -> [v25 build ERROR] -> 1.8780 (QK-norm fix) -> 1.8759 -> 1.8483 -> 1.8749 -> 1.79396 -> 1.7187.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.
